name: Chrome Hearts St. Barth Exclusive Pants Blue Fleur Knee Leather Carpenters
basis_of_authenticity: Dealer listing: sold as authentic by YP Collective. No outside legit check; the basis is the dealer only.
model: St. Barth exclusive (dealer): black leather carpenter pants, blue fleur knee trim, button fly.
what_the_tags_read: Leather label: embossed scroll, CHROME HEARTS in gothic letters, "MADE IN U.S.A." in plain capitals under it. Stitched all round.
Leather tab under the label: only its top edge is in the photo; the number is not legible.
Composition tag: "BODY: LEATHER: COW / LINING: 100% COTTON / LEATHER 2: CALF"; "CORPS: CUIR: VACHE / DOUBLURE: 100% COTON / CUIR 2: VEAU"; "MADE IN U.S.A.".

White printed care tag: five care symbols, "PROFESSIONAL LEATHER DRY CLEAN ONLY", "NETTOYAGE À SEC PROFESSIONNEL DU CUIR UNIQUEMENT", then Japanese, Korean and Chinese lines; CHROME HEARTS scroll sideways on the facing tag.
Lining: black fabric with tone-on-tone Chrome Hearts emblems.
